title: Border collie
text: A herding dog from the Anglo-Scottish border, known for its focus and stamina.

title: Greyhound
text: The fastest dog breed, built for sprinting up to about 70 km/h.

title: Siamese cat
text: A slender, talkative cat breed from Thailand, with blue eyes and a pointed coat.

title: Barn owl
text: A pale nocturnal owl that hunts rodents by sound.

title: Basalt
text: A dark volcanic rock that forms when lava cools quickly.

title: Marble
text: A rock made by heating limestone; sculptors prize it.
